title: Face Tracking
description: Drop a video — the frame follows the face with a smooth, After Effects-style camera move.
dropLabel: Drop a video here or click to browse
dropHint: MP4, MOV or WebM — up to 10 minutes
zoomLabel: Drag toward the center for more zoom, toward the edge for less
zoomHint: Zoom crops into the frame and scales it back up, so a little softness is normal.
coverageWarning: A face was visible in only {{percent}}% of the video — the camera holds or glides through the rest.
hint: Runs on your computer. One face is followed: the largest one, staying with it when others appear.
